title: Did Tom Kernan turn up?
html_source: Tom Kernan is the pivotal character in “Grace”, the second-to-last story in Joyce’s Dubliners. Kernan falls down a flight of stairs while drunk in a Dublin pub. His friend, Jack Power takes him home in a carriage. Later, his friends, including Jack Power and Martin Cunningham persuade Tom Kernan to join them on a Jesuit retreat hoping to restore his faith.
